text: マリオが　バケツを　かぶって　あるいて　いく　ゲームだ！
note: This is Mario & Wario, a 1993 Super Famicom game made by Game Freak, the developers of Pokémon, and released only in Japan. In it Mario walks blindly with a bucket stuck on his head.
claim: Mario & Wario is a 1993 Japan-only Super Famicom game developed by Game Freak in which Mario walks with a bucket on his head.

check.quote: Mario & Wario is a puzzle-platform game released for the Super Famicom in 1993. It was designed by Satoshi Tajiri and developed by Game Freak. ... it ended up being a Japan-exclusive title. ... Wario drops a random item on the character's head, making them unable to see where they are going.
